no_shadow_run_rule: every observed call executes exactly once per run (duplicate tag throws); fixture inputs with getters/setters/symbols/cycles are rejected before execution; no eager spreads, wholesale serialization, or early getter/proxy walks; backend selection precedes operations and never retries across backends
observer_cli: bun packages/testkit/conformance/ports/observations.mjs [--workload <id>...] [--seed <n>] [--check <baseline.json>] [--pretty]; CAN_OBS_HEAD pins source commit in report

oracle_seed_rules.baseline: first granted run's stdout (canonical JSON incl. digest) is the frozen oracle; later runs verify with --check (digest + per-observation diffs; any drift fails loudly, never silently)
oracle_seed_rules.oracle_inputs: oracles are pinned fixture bytes/traces from granted runs, never the sibling implementation under test; two wrappers calling the same helper is never the sole oracle
oracle_seed_rules.seeds: --seed selects stub-random sequences deterministically (default 1); all fixture inputs are fixed literals; no Date.now/Math.random/clock reads inside workloads

record_schema.digest: sha256 over canonical [workload, name, actual] records (excludes timestamps; stable across machines)
record_schema.observation: {name, actual} where actual is a plain value or {ok:false, error:{name, message, code?, violations?}}
